    Tuition fees

Allen and Nesta Ferguson Charitable Trust Scholarships LSTM 2026 Requirements

To be eligible for an Allen and Nesta Ferguson Charitable Trust Scholarship, applicants must:

    Be a national of a low- or middle-income country as defined by the scholarship guidelines
    Have gained admission (or applied) to an eligible master’s programme at LSTM
    Demonstrate academic merit and potential in fields related to global health, tropical medicine, or public health
    Show commitment to applying the knowledge gained for the benefit of their home country
    Be intending to return to a LMIC on completion of their course 
    Specific eligibility criteria (including country lists and programme requirements) are outlined on LSTM’s scholarship page.

Required Documents for Allan and Nesta Ferguson Charitable Trust Scholarships LSTM 2026

Applicants are typically expected to provide:

    A completed online application to the chosen master’s programme at LSTM
    Academic transcripts and degree certificates
    Personal statement outlining career goals and scholarship impact in not more than 700 words including:
        That you are an LMIC national and ordinarily domiciled in an LMIC 
        Explain your academic goals and/or research interests in connection to the course(s) you have applied for at LSTM 
        Clearly outline the impact that your studies will have to support your career, reducing health inequality and providing health leadership. 
         Letters of recommendation (as per programme requirements)
        Evidence of nationality/eligibility from an eligible country
